purpose: Form NCLT-15 is used as a summons for the production of documents in the custody of a public officer other than a court.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Determine if the documents needed are in the custody of a public officer other than a court.
Prepare an application on plain paper as required under Rule 131(2).
Address the summons in Form NCLT-15 to the concerned Head of the Department or specified authority.
checklist: Ensure the application sets out the document for which production is sought.
Include the relevancy of the document in the application.
State whether an application for a certified copy was made to the proper officer and the result if a certified copy would serve the purpose.
Address the summons to the concerned Head of the Department or authority specified by the Tribunal.
